requirement: Install compliant kitchen ventilation and hood per Israeli standard for businesses over 50 m² or 20 seats that use gas.
authority: Ministry of Health / Fire Brigade / Municipality

requirement: Install a grease trap and keep documented maintenance for businesses that serve meat.
Annual certification of the gas system by a licensed installer and proper safety signage.
Maintain food temperature logs during delivery and use appropriate transport equipment.

Post the legal notice that alcohol is not sold/served to under-18s; verify ID. Sign must be 50×40 cm, black letters on white, letter size 2.5×2.5 cm, mounted at 1.80–2.20 m and illuminated during opening hours.
source_ref: Sec. 3.6 / 3.6.1 (alcohol sales signage and ID check)

requirement: Install CCTV covering the entrance (facing outward) and the business façade outward to the specified distance; interior cameras must enable facial identification at entry.

CCTV must support auto exposure/iris, night recording, ≥25 FPS, avoid aiming at bright light, enable facial identification at entry. Recordings kept ≥14 days, at ≥1.3 MP (or equivalent), exportable to removable media, and viewable on a connected screen.

Install and maintain potable water systems in line with Israeli standards (e.g., TI 1205 for water supply systems, TI 1525 for building maintenance/services, TI 5452 for products in contact with drinking water) and Ministry of Health guidance.
source_ref: Chapter on water supply: TI 1205, TI 1525, TI 5452; MoH guidance

requirement: Provide sufficient lidded containers and designated storage to prevent nuisances; keep waste room sanitary; comply with planning regulations for refuse storage and removal.
Maintain operational exterior lighting at all times for entrances and façade areas used by the public.
